# has authority level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel`](gmeow-hasAuthorityLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAuthorityLevel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The authority grade an issuing system claims for this norm. NOT functional: in a multi-source merge, sources may grade the same norm differently, and those claims coexist rather than collapse ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9) — the kernel-axis convention).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) -> [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md)

Use [`gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel`](gmeow-hasAuthorityLevel.md) from [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) to [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

[`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md), [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the authority grade an issuing system claims for a norm, referencing the ordered [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md) vocabulary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single grade in a merge — sources may grade the same norm differently and those claims coexist, so keep it non-functional — and avoid reading it as the precedence outcome (that is solver work over [`gmeow:overrides`](gmeow-overrides.md)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel`](gmeow-hasAuthorityLevel.md) at a [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md) individual; the solver compares levels via [`gmeow:strongerThan`](gmeow-strongerThan.md) when resolving conflicts.

- ex:n1 [`gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel`](gmeow-hasAuthorityLevel.md) [`gmeow:authorityAbsolute`](../individuals/gmeow-authorityAbsolute.md).
